job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering
job.pay_full: $190,000 – $267,000 a year base salary, plus equity (restricted stock units)

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with 100,000+ active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. Its Infrastructure Engineering team gives Reddit's developers a reliable, scalable and automated foundation — compute, deployments, storage and high-performance messaging — on a single opinionated technology stack. This centralized role hires across several teams: Messaging, Compute, Build & Deployment, Consumer IAM (authentication, authorization and account infrastructure), Core Systems & Libraries, Security, and Governance, Risk & Compliance.
duties: Partner with product management, design, data science and iOS, Android and web engineers to turn business and user needs into reliable, low-latency solutions
Own the full software lifecycle of major initiatives: design docs, API contracts, development, testing, rollout and observability
Design, build and evaluate A/B experiments, using tools like BigQuery, HEX or Firebase to analyze user behavior
Build and maintain scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services
Set engineering best practices, improve developer workflows and mentor teammates
Select, scope and drive high-leverage projects, and build a more performant, scalable architecture around authentication, authorization and identity
needs: 5+ years building internet-scale software, ideally with a focus on machine learning storage infrastructure
Software development in one or more general-purpose languages such as Golang, Python, C++ or Java
Experience with essential cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, GCP)
Hands-on experience implementing features, optimizations and bug fixes in distributed messaging systems
Excellent communication with engineering, data science, machine learning and product stakeholders
Degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technical field
details.benefits: Base salary $190,000 – $267,000 a year (the same range for all US locations); final offers depend on skills, experience and credentials. The role is also eligible for equity in restricted stock units, and depending on the position, possibly commission. Benefits include comprehensive healthcare and income replacement programs, a 401(k) with employer match, family planning support, gender-affirming care, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off, and generous paid parental leave.
notes: The posting may span more than one career level
One centralized role hiring across several infrastructure teams
Reasonable accommodations are available during the interview process
